ambiguity_notes: Grade: ICE 0/10 on 31 Jan with no documentation of wakefulness or unarousability, so range 3-4 (A33). Record Grade 2 is below both ends, so both readings give 7.2 and the category is 7.2, not 7.5 (section 7.5 condition). Tremor on 01 Feb is an excluded symptom.
